CustomObject.description: Poll watermark for the inbound (HubSpot to Salesforce) direction: one row per (SObject, portal). Custom Metadata cannot be written from Apex, so the cursor cannot live there -- this object plays the same "Apex must remember something between runs" role that HS_Sync_Tombstone__c already plays for deletes. Reports and search are ON because these rows are the primary operational answer to "is inbound running, and how far has it got?".
CustomObject.label: HS Inbound Cursor
